item.title: CBP Officers Seize Nearly Half a Million Dollars in Cocaine at Eagle Pass Port of Entry
item.description: EAGLE PASS, Texas — U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) officers at the Camino Real International Bridge intercepted more than $488,000 worth of cocaine hidden in a commercial tractor-trailer, authorities confirmed Monday.The seizure took place on Aug. 9 when CBP’s Office of Field Operations (OFO) officers encountered a 2007 Volvo ISX tractor entering the United States from Mexico.
